Founder real-time: 'IDUNA has abandoned pull requests bring them in fix the conflicts'. Merged claude/cool-wright-s0y42o (PR #20, forked 2026-09-25, real diff 7476 insertions/4249 deletions vs its own fork point -- the deletions are almost entirely a stale go:embed'd JS bundle being replaced, not real code churn). Real conflicts: CHANGELOG.md, App.css (two independent additive blocks -- video-editor + animator/rig-tools CSS -- whose shared closing brace got matched as common context by git's diff, needed to be split back into two), dist/index.html (deferred to a full rebuild). App.tsx and main.go auto-merged cleanly (new Video tab / route registrations were non-overlapping). go build/vet/test all clean. GitHub auto-closed PR #20 as merged once pushed. commit IDUNA@796ff8b.

⚓ ☃
title: Merged abandoned PR #20: NOCK video editor with phone uploads
